test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Enjoying or affording warm secure shelter or cover and opportunity for ease and contentment
solution: The correct answer is: **Snug**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Snug **is a one-word substitute for the given group of words. • It means enjoying or affording warm secure shelter or cover and opportunity for ease and contentment. (आराम और संतुष्टि के लिए गर्म सुरक्षित आश्रय या आवरण और अवसर का आनंद लेना या वहन करना) • **Example**: *She felt snug in her cosy blanket on the chilly winter evening.* • The word is often used to describe a cosy and comfortable space, such as a warm and snug bed or a snug cabin in the woods. Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Undisturbed **means not interrupted or interfered with. (बाधित या हस्तक्षेप नहीं किया गया) • **Easeful **means comfortable and relaxed. (आरामदायक) • **Untroubled **means free from worry or anxiety. (चिन्ता से मुक्त) 17e:T88d, The correct answer is: **Magnanimous**.
